paragraphs.text: Evra is an avatar born from the destruction of Halcyon on Dominaria .

Ten thousand years ago, the ancient Thran Empire was assaulted from within by the monstrous Phyrexians . At the culmination of the Thran Civil War , a massive effort of magical technology destroyed the Thran capital of Halcyon . The forces that were unleashed created the avatar Evra, an embodiment of the Thran's achievement and a silent witness to the city's destruction.
